title: LocationSchema
description: see http://hl7.org/fhir/json.html#schema for information about the FHIR Json Schemas

allOf.description: Details and position information for a physical place where services are provided  and resources and participants may be stored, found, contained or accommodated.

identifier.description: Unique code or number identifying the location to its users.

status.description: The status property covers the general availability of the resource, not the current value which may be covered by the operationStatus, or by a schedule/slots if they are configured for the location.

name.description: Name of the location as used by humans. Does not need to be unique.

alias.description: A list of alternate names that the location is known as, or was known as in the past.

description.description: Description of the Location, which helps in finding or referencing the place.

physicalType.description: Physical form of the location, e.g. building, room, vehicle, road.

position.description: The absolute geographic location of the Location, expressed using the WGS84 datum (This is the same co-ordinate system used in KML).

partOf.description: Another Location which this Location is physically part of.
